# Delta Air Lines to present at the Morgan Stanley Global Consumer & Retail Conference


Staff Writer


Nov 18, 2026 5:00pm


Delta Air Lines (NYSE:[DAL](https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/delta-air-lines-to-present-at-the-morgan-stanley-global-consumer--retail-conference-302944437.html#financial-modal) ) will present at the Morgan Stanley Global Consumer & Retail Conference at 8:00 a.m. ET on Wednesday, Dec. 2, 2026.


A live webcast of this event will be available at[ir.delta.com](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4826738-1&h=4054902242&u=https%3A%2F%2Fir.delta.com%2Fhome%2Fdefault.aspx&a=ir.delta.com) and an online replay will be available shortly after the webcast is complete.
